newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lithuanian carrier begins Lithuania-Russia service.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian carrier begins Lithuania-Russia service.

text.p: Lithuania's state-owned carrier Lithuanian Airlines will begin scheduled passenger flights from Vilnius and Palanga to St Petersburg from June 13, the company's general agent in the Russian city said on Tuesday.

Aeroprit, which represents Lithuanian Airlines in St Petersburg, said that the airline would operate 30-seat SAAB 340B aircraft three times a week from Vilnius and twice a week from Palanga, a Baltic resort.
Lithuanian Airlines plans to merge with Aviation Company Lietuva and should be privatised soon.

Currently, Lithuanian Airlines operates three Boeing 737-200, two SAAB 340Bs, a Jetstar and five Russian-made Tupolev Tu-134 jets. It also is in talks to sell its 11 Yalovlev Yak-42 aircraft to Pakistan carrier Bhoia Airline.
